title: Q16 Sequence of statements on performance minutes
subject: Polity
caption: Flowchart of the logical sequence of statements P, Q, R, S in a fifteen‑minute performance scenario.
altText: A top‑down flowchart starts with a Start node, moves to Statement P, then a decision diamond asks if five minutes have elapsed; if yes it proceeds to Statement Q, otherwise it loops back. After Q, another decision checks if ten minutes have elapsed; if yes it proceeds to Statement R, otherwise loops back to Q. Statement R leads to Statement S, which leads to the End node. This diagram shows the correct chronological order of the four statements within the fifteen‑minute performance.
